create_InferenceClient: create an InferenceClient instance with an HF API key from environment variable
create_chat_completion: create a chat completion call sending text and image URL to a vision-language model
build_vlm_query: build a multimodal query combining text prompt and image URL for vision-language inference
run_inference_vlm: run inference on a vision-language model to describe an image in one sentence
access_completion_message: access the first completion message from an InferenceClient chat response
